messages:
maria: Heads-up — main CI is red after the merge for #427. Failing: integration::model_cache_eviction. Looks intermittent in the logs. Can someone do a surgical rerun that preserves the build cache (no image rebuild)?
cheng: yeah saw it. Failure looks infra-y — kv store timeout. You can resubmit just the failing axis with the no-image flag.
sam: how do I target only the matrix axis? job id is 4829134, axis=py38-integration
cheng: run `cictl rerun --job 4829134 --axis py38-integration --no-image`. If you want to scope to the test file: `--test-filter tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_eviction`.
sam: running that now...
devops-bot: Received rerun request for job 4829134 — starting rebuildless rerun (no-image). eta ~3m.
sam: rerun finished — still failing. log shows ConnectionResetError during redis ops, looks like a transient network blip to our kv cluster.
maria: can we bisect to determine when this started? I suspect the redis client bump from last week.
cheng: quick bisect plan: resubmit the last known-good commit (4828000) then the PR commit range. Alternatively, reproduce inside the same CI artifact: `cictl exec --job 4829134 --cmd 'pytest tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_eviction -q'` to run inside the exact build container.
sam: I don't have the artifact locally. Is there a way to run the test inside the CI image remotely?
cheng: yes — `cictl exec --job 4829134 --cmd "pytest tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_eviction -q"` will run inside the existing build container without triggering a new image build.
qa: if it ends up flaky, short-term we can mark the test with a small rerun: `@pytest.mark.flaky(reruns=2)` and open a follow-up to fix the root cause.
maria: agree. Sam — can you attach the logs and open a PR with the temporary rerun if we confirm infra flake? Tag me and Cheng.
sam: will do. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/4829134/console#L234 — running cictl exec now.
devops-bot: job 4829134 console: https://ci.redwood.example/4829134/console — archived artifact: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/4829134.tar.gz
cheng: next steps: 1) cictl exec to attempt local repro; 2) if failure reproduces, run commit bisect; 3) if it's infra, escalate to infra with logs + RTT graphs and mark flaky in test suite until fixed.
maria: thanks team. Sam — ping me when the PR is up, I'll review. Closing this thread for now. :thumbsup:
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/428 — includes `pytest.mark.flaky(reruns=2)` + attached logs. @maria @cheng please review.
